name: USB 3.0 Type-C to SD & microSD 4.0 Card Reader TP-Link UA440C
summary: USB 3.0 Type-C to SD & microSD 4.0 Card Reader
With UA440C, the USB Type-C to SD & microSD 4.0 Card Reader, you can easily transfer data form SD and microSD cards simultaneously, or from one card to the other.
The UA440C is compatible with UHS-II cards, making it easy to quickly move large files from cards with a super fast data reading speed up to 312 MB/s.
SD Interface: 1*SD, USH-II, up to 312 MB/s, 2TB Max
specs:
Operating Temperature: 0°C~40°C (32°F~104°F)
Operating Humidity: 10%~90% non-condensing
Storage Humidity: 5%~90% non-condensing
